style.checked_requirement: Cut-paper plant colony around connected prose/action passage, upper date primary and quieter lower-left identity

observations.observation: Broad green split leaves, dark layered foliage, upright blades and rounded-leaf stems form a substantial irregular colony with visible pink pot mouths and planted branches. Two adjoining citron cavities are cut from this active field.
The date is the largest verbal entry. Event, hours and venue continue immediately beneath it. The lower-left Korean identity is visibly smaller and less heavy, with its Latin companion beside it.

observations.location: central left prose and right care opening
observations.observation: The slogan starts a five-line aligned paragraph; larger letter bodies and broader cavities make all words clearer than the initial. Access, care, invitation and URL form one nearby continuous group across a short stem.
The plant community surrounds and shapes the passage. Date entrance and two content openings are visible; the small lower identity no longer competes as a separate dominant headline.

limits.location: left paragraph ending to right action beginning
limits.observation: The last paragraph line is below the first access line. The adjacent group is easy to find across the short stem boundary, but the handoff requires a slight upward reading turn rather than a shared level ledge.
